page.overview:
Who is Stefan?

Stefan was a minor character who appeared in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Undying Dream”. He was portrayed by James Hyde.

Stefan was a Bola game champion and close friend of Taja. After Taja disappeared, Siro and Kung Lao went to the Bola game field and asked him about Taja. Due to Siro and Stefan butting heads throughout the conversation, Stefan gave Siro and Lao a false lead.
